grain_rationale: dataset.row_count is 13014 with duplicate_row_rate 0.0, meaning no exact duplicate rows exist; airport_code has distinct_count 3 and observed_hour_utc has distinct_count 4341, and 3*4341=13023 is close to the observed row_count of 13014, indicating the table is one weather reading per airport per UTC hour with a small number of missing hour/airport combinations rather than duplication, so the identity tuple (airport_code, observed_hour_utc) absorbs the grain without needing aggregation.

fields.name: airport_code
fields.description: The three-letter station code (samples EWR, JFK, LGA; distinct_count 3; null_rate 0.0) that identifies which airport the observation belongs to.

fields.name: observed_hour_utc
fields.description: The UTC timestamp of the observation, sampled on exact hour boundaries (e.g. 2013-01-01T06:00:00, 07:00:00, 08:00:00) with 4341 distinct values and null_rate 0.0, giving the event its hourly time grain.

fields.name: observed_date_local
fields.description: The local calendar date of the observation (min 2013-01-01, max 2013-06-30, distinct_count 181, null_rate 0.0), a descriptive date label rather than the event timestamp.

fields.name: observed_hour_local
fields.description: The local hour of day as an integer 0-23 (distinct_count 24, null_rate 0.0), labeling time of day rather than measuring a quantity.

fields.name: temp_f
fields.description: Air temperature in Fahrenheit (samples range 10.94 to 93.92, null_rate 0.0), a continuous measured quantity comparable and aggregable across rows.

fields.name: dewpoint_f
fields.description: Dewpoint temperature in Fahrenheit (samples range -9.94 to 73.94, null_rate 0.0), a measured atmospheric quantity.

fields.name: humidity_pct
fields.description: Relative humidity percentage (samples range 12.74 to 100.0, distinct_count 2178, null_rate 0.0), a measured quantity.

fields.name: wind_dir_degrees
fields.description: Wind direction in compass degrees (samples 0 to 360, distinct_count 37); nullable with null_rate 0.016828, likely reflecting calm-wind periods with no defined direction, and it labels direction rather than measuring a summable quantity.

fields.name: wind_speed_mph
fields.description: Wind speed in miles per hour (samples 0.0 to 1048.36058, distinct_count 36), nullable with null_rate 0.000154, a measured quantity aggregable across rows.

fields.name: wind_gust_mph
fields.description: Wind gust speed in miles per hour (samples 16.11092 to 62.14212), nullable with a high null_rate of 0.745505, consistent with gusts only being recorded when conditions exceed a gust threshold.

fields.name: precip_inches
fields.description: Precipitation in inches (samples 0.0 to 1.06, distinct_count 50, null_rate 0.0), a measured and summable quantity.

fields.name: pressure_mb
fields.description: Barometric pressure in millibars (samples 983.8 to 1038.4, distinct_count 430), nullable with null_rate 0.114953, likely due to sensor gaps, and is a measured quantity.

fields.name: visibility_miles
fields.description: Visibility distance in miles (distinct_values capped at 20 including 0.0 through 10.0, null_rate 0.0), a measured quantity.

fields.name: airport_name
fields.description: The full airport name (distinct_values John F. Kennedy International Airport, LaGuardia Airport, Newark Liberty International Airport; null_rate 0.0), a descriptive label for the airport.

fields.name: airport_municipality
fields.description: The municipality hosting the airport (distinct_values New York, Newark; null_rate 0.0), a descriptive location label.

fields.name: airport_elevation_ft
fields.description: The airport's elevation in feet (distinct_values 13, 18, 21; null_rate 0.0), a fixed attribute of the airport rather than a measured quantity that varies per observation.

fields.name: airport_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: The airport's longest runway length in feet (distinct_values 7002, 11000, 14511; null_rate 0.0), a fixed descriptive attribute of the airport.

fields.name: captured_at
fields.description: The timestamp at which the record was captured by the pipeline (samples 2026-09-02T23:26:11 through 23:26:13, null_rate 0.0), a load-time attribute distinct from the observation's own event time.

category_description: One row represents a single weather observation reported at one of three New York area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) for a specific UTC hour, including temperature, dewpoint, humidity, wind, precipitation, pressure, and visibility readings.
purpose: This mapping declares how the contracted silver.silver_airport_weather table enters the gold unified event star as the weather_observations fact category, assigning each profiled column a dimension, measure, or time role, for consumption by the deterministic modeling engine that renders the gold models.
usage: The deterministic modeling engine consumes the rendered mapping contract to generate gold fact and dimension models; the render is validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema, linted with datacontract lint, and reviewed and approved by a human before any model generation occurs.
limitations: The mapping does not resolve or impute the substantial nulls in wind_gust_mph (null_rate 0.745505), pressure_mb (null_rate 0.114953), or wind_dir_degrees (null_rate 0.016828); handling of these nulls is left to downstream consumers. It also does not investigate the small discrepancy between the 13023 airport-hour combinations implied by 3 airports times 4341 distinct observed_hour_utc values and the actual row_count of 13014, leaving reconciliation of missing hours to consumers.
